other_failure_modes.name: Target encoding leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is calculated on the training data and then mapped directly onto the exact same training data without using out-of-fold (OOF) or leave-one-out techniques. This causes severe target leakage, as the target value of a row is included in its own feature representation, leading to catastrophic overfitting.

summary: The agent implements a structurally sound pipeline with a proper train/validation split, extensive feature engineering, and a smartly weighted ensemble. However, it introduces critical target leakage by applying target encoding directly to the training set using means computed from the entire training set, without any out-of-fold strategy.
